dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: I'm a staff member at the Yae Publishing House. I'm here to give a budget report.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: I'm not certain if it is because of slumps in other industries, but there are more and more new authors sending their work to Yae Publishing House...

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: Well, it's a good thing that the publishing industry is booming, but my work is getting busier.

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka
dialogues.text: If this keeps on going, I won't even have time to visit the Kamisato Clan to chitchat with people...
